title: Irish Pilaf with Nutty Flavor
description: A flavorful pilaf dish made with irish ingredients, nutty undertones and a hint of creaminess.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the irish and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add the basmati and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the rice pilaf and stir to combine with the irish and basmati.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the pilaf is cooked through.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the nutty and velvety ingredients.
